versions.content: If PduR_DoIP Tp StartOfReception returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_OK or BUFREQ_E_OVFL, the DoIP module shall react as described in SWS_DoIP_00174 and discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message.
If PduR_DoIPTpStartOfReception returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_ OK or BUFREQ_E_OVFL, the DoIP module shall react as described in SWS_Do IP_00174 and discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message.

If PduR_DoIPTpStartOfReception returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_ OK, the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic negative acknowledge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x08 and discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message.

If PduR_DoIPTpStartOfReception returns BUFREQ_E_NOT_ OK, the DoIP module shall send a diagnostic negative acknowledge message with the diagnostic message negative acknowledge code set to 0x08 and discard all the TCP data until the next DoIP message.
